items.title: Day and Night
items.creator: Sapphire Studios
items.description: Do you enjoy a nice and warm sunny day? Or a cool breezy night? These teens are all ready to enjoy their favorite time of day. How about you?

items.title: Sweet Treats
items.creator: Sapphire Studios
items.description: Do you have a sweet tooth? An irresistible urge for something delicious? This pack will help with all your cravings, from cookies to ice cream. What is your go to treat?

items.title: Kings Court
items.creator: Sapphire Studios
items.description: War is on the horizon! Good versus evil, humans versus demons. Will you join the King's court or side with the forces of chaos?

items.title: Funky Monkeys
items.creator: Yeggs
items.description:
Meet the monkeys: Mark, Michael, Milo, Mia, Meldrick, Max, Matthew, Madelyn, and Mack. We traveled for... a relatively long distance through the jungle just to find monkeys to study in order to create the perfect monkey skins. Talk about going the extra kilometer!

+ Includes 9 boomendous skins!

items.title: Craftable Bases
items.creator: 4KS Studios
items.description: Craft 10 unique bases using regular survival blocks!

items.title: Infinity Skyblock Collectors
items.creator: Cubed Creations
items.description:
NEW! Collect resources and unlock new skyblock islands! You can keep spawning infinite islands and gather new resources! Can you make the most beautiful sky base? This skyblock had everything you need! Ready to go on a new adventure?

+Endless fun!
+Infinity islands!
+Including Nether, End & all biomes!
+Great for multiplayer & singleplayer!

Made by the original creators!

items.title: DelisoJan's Island Tycoon
items.creator: Netherpixel
items.description:
Infinite island, infinite fun! Explore the wide expanses of Island Tycoon in a stunning setting. Have fun under the bright skies across the terrain and assist the townsfolk in improving the island by participating in various activities and unlocking new areas. We welcome you to a classic tycoon experience!

- New upgrades!
- New areas to unlock and explore!

items.title: Street Fashion Teens
items.creator: TNTgames
items.description: Take to the streets in style with Street Fashion Teens! Find just the look for you and show off your fashion sense with 9 unique skins.

items.title: Research Submarine
items.creator: 57Digital
items.description:
Explore the deep oceans in a very special Research Submarine! Learn more about aquatic life in both Minecraft and in real life! Help complete the research tasks and earn a very special prize from the scientists.

- Includes sea exploration vehicles
- Fun and educational tasks
- Includes 10 skins (with 2 free skins)
- By 57Digital

items.title: Teen Witches
items.creator: CubeCraft Games
items.description:
MWAHAHAHA, time to become a witch!

+ 10 spooky skins
+ Perfect for Halloween roleplay
+ FREE skin: Raven

By CubeCraft Games

items.title: Fall Festival
items.creator: Pixelationz Studios
items.description:
The air is getting cooler, and Halloween is drawing near. Now's the time to celebrate the wonderful season of fall! Whether you like wearing trendy fall-inspired outfits or cute creatures, this pack will surely put you in the season's spirit!
-1 free skin

items.title: Dimension Disguise
items.creator: Pixelationz Studios
items.description: Whether in the Nether or the End, have some fun and blend into the terrain with these 12 camouflaged skins!

items.title: Hideous
items.creator: JFCrafters
items.description:
These hideous skins from planet ugly are looking to be liked. "Can you take your time to like them all?"
12 Hideous looking custom skins.

items.title: Craftable Bases
items.creator: Shapescape
items.description:
Making a base has never been this easy! Craft an underground bunker, a training facility, a garage, or maybe even a prison! Find a good place to place them and.. boom! You got yourself a base! What are you going for? A secret underground lair or a survival area in the open air?

+ 30 craftable base modules!
+ Multiplayer and singleplayer

items.title: Hacker
items.creator: Mine-North
items.description:
Dress up as a brave hacker and take over your friend's world! Amaze others with your cool style and let them know who is the ultimate hacker! What are you waiting for? Time to troll them again!

+ 10 epic skins
+ 1 free skin
+ Hacker
+ Mask

Created by Mine-North

items.title: Find the Button
items.creator: GoE-Craft
items.description:
Welcome to the biggest and most advanced finding the button mini-game. Your goal is so simple: Find the button hidden in plain sight and press it. Enjoy a thrilling puzzle with 46 challenging levels.

+ Vibrant Visuals compatible
+ Use hints to help you solve advanced levels
+ Play with friends
+ Unlock bonus levels. Are you lucky or skilled?
+ 6 HD skins
items.changelog:
+ Vibrant Visuals Compatible!
+ Various adjustments and improvements!
+ Build fixes

items.title: Epic Teens
items.creator: Entity Builds
items.description:
Feeling a cut above the rest? So do these teens! Join the coolest squad in school and hang with the popular kids with the Epic Teens skin pack. Set the fashion trends, feel like a celebrity and show your awesome personality to all your new friends.

~Double the skins, double the epicness
~1 FREE skin, for everyone to be part of the squad 
~By Entity Builds

items.title: Legendary Trainers
items.creator: Entity Builds
items.description:
Do you love training animals in Minecraft? Show everyone your dedication to the living friendlies in Minecraft wearing one of these trainers. Whether you want to fight with your dog, lure cows, or ride a horse you can do it in style with the Legendary Trainers skin pack! Now, all you have to do is go out and catch them all!

~By Entity Builds

items.title: Abnormal Biomes
items.creator: Entity Builds
items.description:
There are only so many biomes in Minecraft, so why not add a few more! These teens are stylized for any player looking to show off their creativity and represent a unique biome! Each biome comes with a male and female representation, ready to be picked up by anyone who wants to explore the world in style!

~Custom biome themed skins
~By Entity Builds

items.title: Blocky Mobs
items.creator: Magefall
items.description:
These mobs are sporting a brand new pixel art style and are ready to get gaming!

- 8 skins!

This set includes the following designs:

- Creeper
- Enderman
- Zombie
- Spider
- Skeleton
- Pig
- Ghast
- Slime

items.title: Diamond Thief
items.creator: Lifeboat
items.description:
Pull off the ultimate bank heist! The vault door protects the most valuable diamond in Minecraft. Sneak past cameras, red lasers, arrows, spike traps, and more. Complete parkour levels to uncover the password. Crack the code and become the greatest diamond thief!
- Singleplayer, multiplayer, and roleplay fun
- 8 levels
- 4 jewels to steal
- 5 skins

Run, jump, and steal!

items.title: Sky High Teens
items.creator: Rainbow Theory
items.description: From sunrise to sunset, you’ll always be glowing—even when you’re showing off the dark, midnight sky! With these skins, you can enjoy a beautiful, bird’s-eye view while looking fantastic! Get the Sky High Teens skin pack, and sit amongst the clouds in style.

items.title: Fruit Teens
items.creator: Rainbow Theory
items.description:
These fruit-inspired teens are ready for a fun day in the sun! From the cute strawberry to the trendy banana, these teens show off proudly which fruit they love!

- 8 Tasty Fruit Skins!
- By Rainbow Theory Studios

items.title: Scare Bears HD Skin Pack
items.creator: CupcakeBrianna
items.description:
Prepare for a fright as hollow's eve draws near. These spooky bears have come to life and are taking over! Featuring three scary bear designs with a collection of cool themed outfits for teens. Perfect for roleplay or enjoying a fashionably edgy playthrough.

+ 11 HD skins
+ By CupcakeBrianna
